name: Kings In The Corner
summary: A solitaire-style shedding card game where players build descending red-black piles on four foundations and start corner piles with Kings.
rules_text: Players get chips and 7 cards each. Four cards are placed face up as foundation piles, remaining cards form a draw pile. Each turn a player must ante one chip and the first player starts. Cards must be played in red-black alternating colors in descending rank. Kings must be played immediately to one of four corner spaces; holding a King costs 3 chips penalty. You may move an entire foundation pile onto another if its bottom card fits. You may place any card from hand into an empty foundation. You may make as many moves as you can, then draw one card to end turn; failing to play at least once costs 1 chip, failing to draw costs 1 chip. First to empty hand wins the hand, others pay one chip per card left in hand to the pot, winner takes pot as points. First to 100 points wins.
